sections.title: Nature of the service

Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or exploitation, in whole or in part, without prior written authorization is prohibited.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: This notice and the Stack32 service are governed by French law.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Stack32 service, published by {{companyName}}. By creating an account, using Stack32 or subscribing, you accept these Terms, the Subscription & Sales Terms, and the Refund Policy without reservation.

sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: Stack32 lets you create, test and use AI agents by describing them in natural language. The service includes a builder interface, a live chat with your agents, and a structure view of their configuration. Stack32 is provided as a web application accessible with a compatible browser. As soon as a paid subscription is activated, usage credits may be granted and Pro features become available immediately.

sections.title: 2. Account
sections.body: You must create an account to use the product. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity performed through your account. You must provide accurate information and be at least 15 years old, or have parental consent.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to use Stack32 to generate or spread illegal, harmful or misleading content; not to attempt to bypass technical limits or security measures; not to infringe third-party rights; and not to resell the service without authorization. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.

sections.title: 4. AI-generated content
sections.body: Agents produce content automatically. Despite automated testing, results may be incomplete, inaccurate or inappropriate for your use case. You remain responsible for reviewing and using agent outputs. Stack32 does not guarantee the accuracy of generated content.

sections.title: 5. Your content
sections.body: You retain ownership of the content you submit (prompts, documents, knowledge sources). You grant {{companyName}} the licenses strictly necessary to operate the service, including processing your content through third-party AI model providers.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions, immediate performance and non-refundability
sections.body: Some features require a paid subscription. Prices, billing, withdrawal rights and cancellation are described in the Subscription & Sales Terms and the Refund Policy. By subscribing, you request immediate performance of the digital service (Pro access, credits, agent-building capacity). Under articles L221-18 and L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, you expressly waive your withdrawal right once performance has begun with your prior consent. Started periods are non-refundable, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Availability
sections.body: We strive to keep Stack32 available and reliable, but the service is provided "as is", without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. We may modify or discontinue features with reasonable notice.

sections.title: 8. Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, {{companyName}}'s liability is limited to the amounts you paid for the service during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

sections.title: 9. Termination
sections.body: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. Cancellation of a paid subscription follows the Subscription & Sales Terms (end of the current period, no refund of amounts already paid). We may suspend or terminate accounts in case of breach of these terms, with notice where reasonably possible.

sections.title: 10. Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, first contact us at {{contactEmail}}. Failing an amicable agreement, the competent French courts shall have jurisdiction. If you are a consumer, you may also use consumer mediation under the French Consumer Code.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{companyName}} collects through Stack32, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is {{companyName}} (SIREN {{siren}}, {{rcs}}). Contact: {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Account data (email, name, password hash); profile data provided during onboarding (first name, phone number, role, discovery source, use case); content you submit (prompts, conversations, documents); usage data (features used, technical logs); and billing data processed by our payment provider.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: To provide the service (create and run your agents), to secure accounts, to improve the product, to provide support, to handle billing, and to comply with legal obligations. Legal bases include contract performance, legitimate interest and legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. AI processing
sections.body: Your prompts and connected documents are processed by AI model providers acting as processors, strictly to generate your agents' answers. We do not use your private content to train our own models.

sections.title: 5. Sharing
sections.body: Data is shared only with processors necessary to run the service (IONOS hosting, database, AI model providers, payment provider, analytics), under data-processing agreements. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: Account data is kept while your account is active, then deleted or anonymized within the legal limitation periods. You can request deletion at any time.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French supervisory authority). To exercise your rights, contact {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption in transit, access controls, isolation of customer data and least-privilege access.

sections.title: 9. Transfers outside the EU
sections.body: Some processors may be located outside the European Union. In that case, transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This policy describes the cookies and similar technologies used by Stack32.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device by your browser. They can be strictly necessary to run the service, or used for measurement and personalization.

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies: authentication session, security, language preference. These do not require consent. Measurement cookies: if we add privacy-friendly analytics, this policy will be updated and consent requested where required.

sections.title: 3. Local storage
sections.body: Stack32 uses your browser's local storage to remember your language and, in development mode, to store demo data locally on your device.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can delete cookies and local storage at any time in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent the service from working.

sales.title: Subscription & sales terms
sales.intro: These terms apply to paid subscriptions to Stack32, sold by {{companyName}}. They complement the Terms of use and the Refund Policy.

sections.title: 1. Offer and nature of the service
sections.body: Stack32 is offered as a subscription giving immediate access to a digital service (digital content / electronically supplied service): Pro features, possible allocation of usage credits, and the ability to create and run agents as soon as payment is confirmed. Features and limits of each plan are described at purchase and on the pricing page.

sections.title: 2. Price and payment
sections.body: Prices are shown in the checkout flow, taxes indicated where applicable. Payment is processed by our payment provider. The subscription renews automatically each period until canceled. Payment for a period is a firm order for that period.

sections.title: 3. Immediate performance
sections.body: As soon as payment is confirmed, {{companyName}} immediately performs the service: subscription activation, unlocking of paid features, and where applicable immediate crediting of your usage balance. You may use the service without waiting for the legal withdrawal period to expire.

sections.title: 4. Right of withdrawal — express waiver (French Consumer Code)
sections.body: Under articles L221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, consumers generally have fourteen (14) days to withdraw from a distance contract. However, article L221-28 provides in particular that the withdrawal right cannot be exercised for: (i) the supply of digital content not supplied on a tangible medium where performance has begun with the consumer's prior express consent and express waiver of the withdrawal right; (ii) service contracts fully performed before the end of the withdrawal period where performance began with the consumer's prior express consent and express waiver. By ticking the checkout box and confirming your order, you (a) expressly request that performance begin immediately, (b) acknowledge that the service (access, credits, agent-building capacity) is provided without delay, and (c) expressly waive your withdrawal right. Accordingly, no refund is due under withdrawal for the started period.

sections.title: 5. No refunds for started periods
sections.body: Unless mandatory law provides otherwise, {{companyName}} will not refund amounts already paid for a started subscription period, including early cancellation, non-use, change of mind, or partial use of credits. The Refund Policy details this principle and the very limited exceptions (billing error, major failure attributable to Stack32).

sections.title: 6. Cancellation
sections.body: You may cancel at any time from your billing settings or by contacting {{contactEmail}}. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period: the service and charges continue until the last day of that period, then stop. Cancellation does not give rise to any refund of amounts already collected for the current period, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Price changes
sections.body: We may change prices with at least 30 days' notice. Changes apply from the next renewal. If you disagree, you can cancel before the new price takes effect.

sections.title: 8. Fair use
sections.body: Usage limits (number of agents, runs, knowledge volume, credits) are described per plan. We may throttle abusive usage that threatens platform stability, with notice where possible.

sections.title: 9. Consents collected at checkout
sections.body: Before any payment, you must clearly tick: (1) acceptance of the Terms of use (and related documents, including the refund policy); (2) your request for immediate performance and your express waiver of the withdrawal right. Without these consents, the order cannot be validated.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: This policy sets out the refund rules for Stack32 subscriptions sold by {{companyName}}. It applies to every paid subscription order and complements the Subscription & Sales Terms.

sections.title: 1. Principle: no refunds
sections.body: Stack32 subscriptions are digital services performed immediately. Upon payment, Pro access is activated, usage credits may be granted, and you can create and use agents without delay. Therefore, unless mandatory law provides otherwise, no amount already paid for a started period is refundable — including if you did not use the service, changed your mind, cancel mid-period, or used only part of your credits.

sections.title: 2. Legal basis (French law)
sections.body: Under articles L221-18 and L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the 14-day withdrawal right does not apply when you have expressly requested immediate performance of digital content / an electronically supplied service and expressly waived that right before performance began. These consents are collected via mandatory checkboxes in the checkout flow. As Stack32 is a digital service not supplied on a tangible medium, the waiver is enforceable under the conditions set by law.

sections.title: 3. What payment covers
sections.body: Your payment covers immediate access to the service for the subscribed period: Pro features, capacity to build and run agents, and where applicable the immediate crediting of your usage balance. These elements constitute performance of the service as soon as payment is confirmed.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation ≠ refund
sections.body: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation ends automatic renewal at the end of the current period. It is not a refund request: you keep access until the end of the period already paid, and no pro-rata is paid for unused days, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Limited exceptions
sections.body: We will examine in good faith: (a) duplicate or clearly erroneous charges, refunded in full after verification; (b) a major service outage attributable to Stack32 that prevented you from using the service for a significant part of the period, which may result in a credit or pro-rata refund at our reasonable discretion. Temporary glitches, user error, unsatisfactory agent output, or a change of mind are not grounds for a refund.

sections.title: 6. How to contact us
sections.body: For any billing request, write to {{contactEmail}} with the account email and invoice reference. We reply within 7 business days. Any eventual refund is issued to the original payment method via our payment provider.

sections.title: 7. Mandatory statutory rights
sections.body: Nothing in this policy limits mandatory statutory rights you may have as a consumer, including legal guarantees applicable to digital services where the law so requires.
